decisions.reason: Identifier occurrence is a DOI (valid syntax 10.1007/...) in the url= field of a citation template, a publisher link pointing at it, so role identifier_link stays. But the locked raw-text quote is the whole URL. Guide 3.5 lists whole-URL quoting only for a publisher URL whose path contains /doi/10.; this URL has /chapter/10.1007/..., so it falls under 'anything else: the identifier text'. The item's cp must be the first character of that identifier text (cp 21651). Ambiguous: the guide's URL row could be read as covering any publisher URL; the narrower reading is followed because its wording enumerates the /doi/ form.

corrected_label.notes: identifier text inside the publisher URL (adjudicated: quoted as identifier text, guide 3.5)
